summary: Backend testing completed for Phase 1 Manufacturing ERP features. All 31 tests passed covering: (1) SC with RM → DC → PO → GRN flow, (2) Job Card outsource DC with skip_stock_deduct=true, (3) BOM explosion cost columns, (4) Regression test for SC with RM DC stock deduction.
seed_data_creation: Test data created dynamically with TEST_ prefix for items (RM, SA, FG, Part), BOMs, routings, suppliers, production orders, work orders, SC orders, DCs, POs, and GRNs
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase 1 features verified: (1) SC with RM flow: Create SC → Confirm → Send DC (deducts RM stock) → Create PO from SC (uses job_work_parts with charges as unit_price) → Approve PO → GRN (adds SA stock, marks SC completed). (2) Job Card outsource: Create SC without_material → Confirm → Send DC with skip_stock_deduct=true (NO stock deduction) → Create PO → GRN. (3) BOM explosion returns process_cost_per_unit and total_cost_per_unit fields. (4) Regression: SC with RM DC without skip_stock_deduct correctly deducts stock.

sc_with_rm_po_grn_flow.details: Full flow tested: SC with RM → Send DC (deducts RM stock) → Create PO from SC (job_work_parts with charges as unit_price) → GRN (adds SA stock, completes SC and linked MOs)

job_card_outsource_dc_skip_stock_deduct.details: DC creation with skip_stock_deduct=true does NOT deduct stock. No inventory transaction created. Parts go for processing, not consumed.

bom_explosion_cost_columns.details: BOM explosion endpoint returns process_cost_per_unit and total_cost_per_unit fields for each component.

po_creation_from_sc.details: POST /api/job-work/create-po works for both SC types. PO lines come from job_work_parts (FG/SA items with charges as unit_price).

grn_completes_sc_and_mo.details: GRN against SC-linked PO marks SC as completed and completes linked MOs.

regression_sc_rm_dc_deducts_stock.details: SC with RM DC without skip_stock_deduct (default false) correctly deducts stock.
